import psycopg2
import uuid
import time
import sys

DB_URL = "{{TESTVDB_DB_URL}}"
conn = psycopg2.connect(DB_URL)
conn.autocommit = True
cur = conn.cursor()

# Create extension
cur.execute("CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector")

# Create a unique table name
table_name = "test_count_" + str(uuid.uuid4()).replace("-", "_")

# Create table with vector column
cur.execute(f"""
    CREATE TABLE {table_name} (
        id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
        embedding vector(3),
        metadata text
    )
""")

# Insert entities
num_inserts = 10
for i in range(num_inserts):
    cur.execute(
        f"INSERT INTO {table_name} (embedding, metadata) VALUES (%s, %s)",
        (f"[{i*0.1}, {i*0.2}, {i*0.3}]", f"item_{i}")
    )

# Verify row count
cur.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {table_name}")
actual_count = cur.fetchone()[0]
print(f"Expected count: {num_inserts}, Actual count: {actual_count}")

if actual_count != num_inserts:
    print(f"[DEFECT: DATA_CORRUPTION] Row count mismatch! Expected {num_inserts}, got {actual_count}")
    sys.exit(1)
else:
    print(f"[PASS] Row count matches expected: {num_inserts}")

# Now test with vector index
cur.execute(f"CREATE INDEX ON {table_name} USING hnsw (embedding vector_l2_ops)")

# Insert more entities after index creation
more_inserts = 5
for i in range(num_inserts, num_inserts + more_inserts):
    cur.execute(
        f"INSERT INTO {table_name} (embedding, metadata) VALUES (%s, %s)",
        (f"[{i*0.1}, {i*0.2}, {i*0.3}]", f"item_{i}")
    )

cur.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {table_name}")
actual_count2 = cur.fetchone()[0]
expected_total = num_inserts + more_inserts
print(f"After index + more inserts - Expected: {expected_total}, Actual: {actual_count2}")

if actual_count2 != expected_total:
    print(f"[DEFECT: DATA_CORRUPTION] Row count mismatch after index! Expected {expected_total}, got {actual_count2}")
    sys.exit(1)
else:
    print(f"[PASS] Row count matches expected after index: {expected_total}")
